secondary_sources: Southeast Alaska Regional Dive Fisheries Association (SARDFA)
_provenance.notes: Alaska's commercial dive fisheries target sea cucumbers (Apostichopus californicus, prized in Asian markets), red sea urchins (Mesocentrotus franciscanus), and weathervane scallops (Patinopectes caurinus). These high-value, low-volume fisheries are managed under limited entry with rotational area closures. Sea cucumbers export almost entirely to China and Hong Kong for beche-de-mer processing. Prices range from $0.35-1.20/lb ex-vessel depending on size and quality.
